lines: You're a cheeky little shit. Here's something to take with you to the afterlife. Bare witness to my "Wraith Dance!"
Ryoma had been the first to make a move.
Black haze gushed out from his upraised palm.
It was the miasma that sucks out life force.
The miasma slowly, deliberately extended toward Tokiko, just as it had done when it had defeated the Fuma members earlier.
Wraith Dance, you say? Seems quite slow. ーHagh!!
Tokiko didn't let that stop her from repelling herself away though, putting as much distance between her and the approaching miasma as she could with a large leap.
As she did so, a larger miasma emerged from beneath her feet, taking the form of a wraith.
It had barely missed her as her feet left the ground.
If she had only focused on the miasma extending from his hand, she would have been caught in much the same way as her dead subordinates.
You've got some pretty good instincts. Enough to match that cockiness in suggesting a one-on-one fight with me.
I've heard of this Ninja Art that manipulates Wraiths.
If you're touched by it, your life force will be absorbed and you'll die soon after.
You're well educated for a Fuma, I'll give you that.
Ryoma clapped his miasma-covered hands exaggeratedly.
I've seen what depths you'll sink to, as well.
His applause came to an abrupt stop.
That you would use such an underhanded approach from the very beginning to deal with a little girl like me...
...It seems you aren't even worthy of the honor of a one-on-one duel.
Tokiko had ridiculed Ryoma in a rather cool tone of voice.
Don't get cocky with me! You little shit!
The very next instant, several black Wraiths had appeared from around him.
Now you'll rely on numbers? So simplistic.
Tokiko let the kunai in both hands fly towards Ryoma.
It was Tokiko's signature kunai strike, which would throw off her foe's balance if it hit.
Ryoma didn't even try to avoid it.
Instead, two wraiths had moved quickly to become his shields.
The kunai easily pierced the wraiths, dispersing them as if the miasma had been cleared away.
And yet, two then three more wraiths then popped up to replace them like it was nothing.
Hey, come on, what's the matter!?
Ryoma manipulated the summoned wraiths with a waving movement of his hands.
The wraiths, which had grown more numerous than before, were drifting toward Tokiko and reaching out with their cold touch.
With her quick movements, Tokiko evaded the wraiths' hands...
...and she struck and slashed at them with her kunai to reduce their number while dodging.
Haha! Working up quite the sweat now, aren't you!?
However, with each wraith she defeated, Ryoma would summon even more to take its place.
As a result, the more wraiths Tokiko defeated, the greater their numbers swelled to assault her.
Even though she thought she had been avoiding the Wraiths' attacks, the haze that spread unceasingly had grazed her body without her noticing.
In that manner, Tokiko's life force had been chipped away little by little.
Haah... haah... haagh... So he had this planned... hn...
Individually, each wraith was quite weak. But their sheer numbers overwhelmed her as they spawned endlessly, allowing them to steal little Tokiko's stamina.
By the time she'd realized it, it had been too late.
It's over! Ninja Art: Wraith Dance, Thousand Hands of the Reaper!!!
Countless wraith arms emerged from the earth and attacked Tokiko, threatening to drag her forcefully into the underworld.
Tokiko tried to jump away, but she no longer had the strength left for such a feat.
Over a thousand wraiths slammed into Tokiko.
She could feel her energy being rapidly extracted from her body.
It was like her soul had been directly grasped by ice-cold hands.
With no means left to fight back, Tokiko fell to her knees.
From within her rapidly fading consciousness, Tokiko could see Kotaro rushing over to aid her.
Don't interfere, you shitty little brat!
With lightning movements, Ryoma had taken firm hold of Kotaro's arm.
The Fuma will perish here, by the hand of Karasuno Ryoma!!!
But first, watch that precious little girl of yours drop dead!
Waaagh!! Let the young lord goooo!!
Gaiza tried to attack Ryoma with a dagger he had concealed as he wailed uncontrollably.
Aagh!? What do you think you're doing, brat!?
Ryoma's leg swung to kick Gaiza away in agitation.
Though the blow had lightly grazed him, Gaiza was sent rolling across the ground and flopped unconscious.
Gaiza!! How dare you do that to little Gaiza!! You coward!!
Look at the mouth on you! You little Fuma shit! I'll soon send you after that brat!
Ryoma stomped the ground with a loud thud...
They laid their cold hands on Kotaro's body.
A terrible feeling of exhaustion had assailed Kotaro's entire body.
No use... I can't move... Ughh...
By then, the two surviving Fuma members had also been taken hold of by the countless wraiths.
There was nobody left who could save Kotaro.
Hahahahahahaha!! Die! Die! Diiiiee!! You loser Fuma shits!!
Just as Ryoma was mocking them...
...a booming roar that seemed to pierce the heavens echoed over the area.
The wraiths that had been about to claim Kotaro instantly vanished.
Following that, the thousand wraith spirits that had been suppressing Tokiko began to swell and eventually burst.
Dammit!! What the hell's going on!?
Tokiko, who should've been long dead after being swallowed up by the wraiths, appeared in a blinding flash of light.
Ryoma, and indeed all those in the area, were heavily intimidated by the reverberations of this voice as it passed through them.
『Perish!!! Clairvoyant Eye Ultimate Skill: Cleansing Eye of the Dragon Lord!!!』
Accompanying Tokiko's booming voice, a guardian deity had emerged from behind her.
The surroundings instantly became enveloped in purifying flame.
All of the wicked wraiths were annihilated,
and Ryoma, the one manipulating them, was also burned by the flames.
And after the illumination from the flames had extinguished themselvesー
Ryoma found himself not burned to death in the slightest.
He had just experienced the sensation of his flesh, bones, and even his soul being burned to death.
And yet once that light was gone, he was still alive. Albeit with his whole body in a state of lethargy.
Not one part of him was burned. Not even as much as a single scald.
Did that mean that all of those vivid sensations had been illusions?
Tokiko, having unleashed such terrifying power, fainted and collapsed on the spot.
Damn! She scared the hell out of me... haah... haah...
Ryoma dragged his staggering body over to Tokiko to deliver the finishing blow.
A voice had spoken, stopping Ryoma.
The line of the encircling Igawa troops parted, and the person who appeared was none other thanー
That girl... Fuma Tokiko, is my guest.
Asagi cast a fleeting glance at Tokiko who remained collapsed on the ground as she spoke.
Your guest!? Nonsense!!! This girl is the butler of the Fuma head family. In other words, an enemy of the Igawa!
The battle is over. There's no need for any more bloodshed.
Ridiculous! I, Ryoma, am acting on the orders of the elders. Even you cannot stop me, Asagi-sama.
So you're willing to fight me then?
Asagi's voice had suddenly lowered threateningly.
Ryoma instinctively backed away and broke into a cold sweat from the pressure she exuded.
It was the definition of being scared to death.
You'll incur the wrath of the elders...
He did his best to speak while also not looking directly into Asagi's eyes.
Inform them that they are free to come to me if they have anything they wish to say.
And release that child. Or do you intend to take him home with you?
Such was Ryoma's fear of Asagi that he had completely forgotten he was still holding onto Kotaro's arm, and with an irritated click of his tongue, he then let him drop.
Kotaro silently glared back at the Ryoma.
Muttering those words under his breath, Ryoma then turned to look at Tokiko one last time who had put the fear of death in him with her flames before taking his leave with his 100-plus subordinates.
After pushing himself for so long despite his young age, Kotaro's body finally wavered.
Kotaro did not answer her, but instead made his way over to Tokiko who remained collapsed.
Tokiko! Are you alright, Tokiko!?  Get it together!
Let her rest. I witnessed how she fought with that meddlesome Igawa.
Holding Gaiza in her arms who had been sent flying by Ryoma's kick, Asagi came over to Kotaro.
This one is safe as well. I apologize for such violent acts committed against children. I don't want you to think that all the Igawa are like that.
You're saying you're any different, Igawa Asagi?
Kotaro had looked up directly into Asagi's face.
Asagi gazed back into Kotaro's eyes.
If Fuma Tokiko says she'll entrust you with the future, then I will do the same.
The battle is over. From now on, the Taimanin will be united as one to oppose the demons.
Fuma Kotaro of the next generation... welcome to Gosha.
A vivid encounter between the young Fuma Kotaro and the Almighty Taimanin...
I heard a voice calling me.
It had been Tokiko calling to me.
Did you have a bad dream?
You were moaning a great deal in your sleep...
Tokiko was looking down at me with concern.
I could see the blue sky behind her.
...Well, whatever it was I don't remember it. Did you need something, Tokiko?
Headmistress Asagi is calling for you. She says it's urgent.
I see. I'll head on over.
I picked myself up from where I'd been sleeping.
And master, please be sure to attend your English classes.
I'm always being teased by Shizuru-sensei because of your continual absence from her class, master.
I did indeed skip English again today and had been reading a book under the shade of one of the trees in the schoolyard. I must've dozed off at some point without realizing.
M-Master!? Do you have an upset stomach or the like?
I'd simply responded normally, but Tokiko widened her eyes as if she'd seen something completely abnormal.
Usually whenever I say anything, you always make excuses for your idleness.
What're you talking about? So I shouldn't go to English class?
Thank you. Then I take my leave.
Tokiko smiled cheerfully as she turned to depart.
Watching her leave... I suddenly felt the urge to call out to her.
On a sudden impulse, I had reached out and hugged Tokiko from behind.
Tokiko sounded somewhat surprised by this action.
I just want to stay like this for a moment... Tokiko...
Did that bad dream make you regress into a child?
A laugh slipped out from her as Tokiko shook her head. She then turned to face me and hugged me back tightly.
You'll always be a child, won't you, master?
Just like in the old days.
『Was it worth entrusting the future to me?』
I refrained from speaking those words aloud.
A cold breeze blew in from the mountains.
A breeze that was a sign of summer's end...
